main_text.p: sentire, & beatam, ad quam omnes pii aspirant, gloriam, certa spe expectare voluisti. Oramus te clementissime Pater, ut haec beneficia indies in nobis amplifices, animos nostros in vera pietate, assiduaque tuorum in nos meritorum consideratione confirmes, Ecclesiam potenti tua dextera defendas, studia literarum, & scholas doctrinae coelestis, earumque pios doctores in his praesertim regionibus benigne ferves. Inprimis autem, serenissimum nostrum & clementissimum Principem ac Dominum, D. FRIDERICUM IV. Electorem Palat.tanquam pupillam oculi tui custodias, omnibus corporis atque animi bonis locupletissime expleas, diuturnam ac longaevam in aurea pace, in felici ac tranquilla patriae florentis gubernatione, in fideli Ecclesiae defensione, ejus Celsitudinem vitam concedas, minaces hostium in gregem pusillum tuum furores compescas, ut te in hac vita, inter ruentis mundi fragores conservati, & in aeterna illa, gloriam immortalem adepti, immortalibus tibique gratissimis laudib.cum aeterno tuo filio, Spirituque sancto benignissimum patrem, fortissimumque Deum celebremus.

page.notes: Page number "522" is printed in old-style figures and is read with doubt. The running head reads "EXERCITAT. THEOLOG." in small capitals. "IV." after FRIDERICUM is printed with a mark that may be a stop or a flourish. The word "Celsitudinem" is printed "Celfitudinem" with a long s; it has been written with a plain s. "gratissimis" is printed "gratiffimis" (long s). "Palat.tanquam" and "laudib.cum" are printed without spaces and are kept as printed. No marginal notes, no signature.
